example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ম্যাচ জিতে বরমাল্য গ্রহণ করল।
তাদের সাফল্যের পর সকলে বরমাল্য পরিয়ে অভিনন্দন জানাল।
example_sentences_in_english: He won the match and received the garland of victory.
After their success, everyone congratulated them by draping victory garlands.
note: This idiom draws from traditional garland-giving customs in Bengali culture, often linked to weddings but extended metaphorically to victories.
